summary_1line: A loyal jackal clears his name yet leaves the tiger king, then Bhishma begins a cautionary tale about an idle camel destroyed by his own boon.

image_candidates.scene_text: The tiger king embraces the vindicated jackal while the jackal, eyes filled with tears, bows and asks permission to end his life by a vow.
During a violent storm, a giant camel stretches a hundred-yojana neck into a mountain cave while a hungry jackal couple begins gnawing at it.
Inside the dark cave, the jackal and his mate cling to the camel’s long neck, tearing at it as the helpless animal writhes in the rainstorm outside.
